data.spec: Source apps/server/src/agent/interpret.ts and packages/contracts/src/index.ts. Interpreter(text:string, station:Station, context?:{openRequests?:OfficeRequest[],onProgress?:(step:{stage:string,detail:string})=>void}) → Promise<Interpretation>. Interpretation = {intent:'purchase'|'maintenance'|'clarification',item_id:string|null,summary:nonempty string <=500,quantity:integer 1..20,question:string|null}. STT supplies text with station context; STT implementation/signature is still owned by existing task stt and must be published there before callers depend on it.
